concept: A self-portrait of the skill: every claim in the voiceover is shown as a primitive shape doing that job.
law: Light paper, near-black ink and four flat primaries with roles: vermilion = the spoken word, blue = machine/code, yellow = sound, green = done. Medium-weight Archivo, big shapes, small type.
motif: A single circle (the 'clip') that becomes a square (the 'video'), then a cursor, a waveform dot, a mouth, and finally the O of the wordmark.

options.name: A
options.idea: Primitive system: geometry that reorganizes on light paper, shapes are the heroes, type is medium.

options.name: B
options.idea: Halftone and code: mono-led, dithered field resolving into words on a 16 px grid.
